name: recipetogroceries
description:
Recipes to Groceries

This will be a recipe sharing and grocery list making website where you can pick meals and automatically create a shopping list.

Test it here!



Eventually, it will include the following features:
  • Create and share recipes
  • Use those recipes to create an ingredients list for grocery shopping
  • Seperate groceries into different stores for ease of shopping
  • Be completely free to use (hopefully!)
I'm also hoping to include these features if I can figure out how to do so:
  • Import recipes from images
  • Import recipes from other websites
  • Combine similiar ingredients
  • Have unit conversions
